name: Filling the Soul Gem
summary: Deep in the jungle of Stranglethorn Vale, an attempt is made to preserve the young troll Yenniku. With the youth caught in a trance, a prepared soul gem is brought forth to capture his spirit.

sections.title: A Trance in the Jungle
sections.body: Following the effort to save Yenniku, you stand face to face with the young troll in Stranglethorn Vale. His mind is lost, caught entirely in another place while he remains motionless before you. The only path forward involves the enchanted gem prepared specifically to hold his essence.

sections.title: The Vessel
sections.body: Pressing the gem to Yenniku's forehead pulls his spirit directly into the stone. As the essence is drawn away, his physical form shudders and collapses into an empty, mindless shell.

faq.q: What condition is Yenniku in when you reach him?
faq.answer: Yenniku stands stunned and unresponsive, his thoughts held far away from his physical surroundings.

faq.q: What item is used on Yenniku?
faq.answer: A soul gem brought from Stranglethorn Vale is used to interact with the young troll.

aliases: prereq for filling the soul gem
faq.answer: This encounter directly follows the events of Saving Yenniku in the jungles of Stranglethorn Vale.
